name: San Mamés de Burgos (Spain)
description: Square flag divided horizontally by a wavy line, white above and red below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Mamés de Burgos (a lion on red within a bordure of crosses).
history: Municipal flag of San Mamés de Burgos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: San Mamés de Burgos arms — lion within a bordure of crosses
